purpose: Correct mirrored release-catalog stats only when the Hasbro packaging photo confirms the original model and a second source connects that model to this G3084 repack. Never guess values.

OWN-G3084-05.reason: G1682 has the same yellow model reissued in G3084-05. Its retail box back prints the full Blade 34/22/44. Round Assist is 10/10/20; the Fort Main component is thus 24/12/24. phstudy G1682 and G3084 values were each five points too high.

OWN-G3084-06.reason: G1683, reused in G3084-06, has full Blade attack 28 defense 22 stamina 50 visibly printed on Hasbro retail packaging. Slash Assist has 20/10/10; Wriggle Main must be 8/12/40, also matching independent part DB. phstudy G1683 and G3084 values were each five points too high.

safetyNotes: Corrections apply to the two actual G3084 reissued tops, not to unrelated G1682/G1683 inventory that the owner does not possess.
Only overwrite Attack, Defense, Stamina. Do not modify Ratchet, Bit, Lock Chip, Assist Blade, weights, owned inventory or image mapping.
Keep raw catalog values under originalCatalog and the corrected entry's verification metadata; allow reproducible auto-sync.
The performance-score difference is a printed-data correction, NOT a measured attack-speed, burst rate or win rate.
